## Gender Differences.

```{r codeGender, include=FALSE}
## Combine all data
race.Wts.Gen.malALL <- ts(c(race.Wts.Gen.mal, race.Wts.Gen.malNEW), start = c(2007, 1), frequency = 12)
age.Wts.Gen.malALL <- ts(c(age.Wts.Gen.mal, age.Wts.Gen.malNEW), start = c(2007, 1), frequency = 12)
sex.Wts.Gen.malALL <- ts(c(sex.Wts.Gen.mal, sex.Wts.Gen.malNEW), start = c(2007, 1), frequency = 12)
race.Wts.Gen.femALL <- ts(c(race.Wts.Gen.fem, race.Wts.Gen.femNEW), start = c(2007, 1), frequency = 12)
age.Wts.Gen.femALL <- ts(c(age.Wts.Gen.fem, age.Wts.Gen.femNEW), start = c(2007, 1), frequency = 12)
sex.Wts.Gen.femALL <- ts(c(sex.Wts.Gen.fem, sex.Wts.Gen.femNEW), start = c(2007, 1), frequency = 12)

## RACE ------
## Individual trajectories -------
## Fit to Males
Race.arimaMale <- auto.arima(race.Wts.Gen.mal, stepwise = FALSE, approximation = FALSE)
forecast.Race.Male <- forecast(Race.arimaMale, h = 60)
forecast.Race.MaleLONG <- forecast(Race.arimaMale, h = 2400)
min.bound.race.male <- min(which(forecast.Race.MaleLONG$lower[,"95%"]<=0))/12
mean.race.male <- min(which(forecast.Race.MaleLONG$mean<=0))/12
max.bound.race.male <- min(which(forecast.Race.MaleLONG$upper[,"95%"]>=2*race.Wts.Gen.mal[1]))/12 
decomp.race.male <- decompose(race.Wts.Gen.mal)
p.ch.race.male <- (decomp.race.male$trend[7] - decomp.race.male$trend[114])/decomp.race.male$trend[7]
r.ch.race.male <- decomp.race.male$trend[7] - decomp.race.male$trend[114] 
## Fit to Females
Race.arimaFemale <- auto.arima(race.Wts.Gen.fem, stepwise = FALSE, approximation = FALSE)
forecast.Race.Female <- forecast(Race.arimaFemale, h = 60)
forecast.Race.FemaleLONG <- forecast(Race.arimaFemale, h = 2400)
min.bound.race.female <- min(which(forecast.Race.FemaleLONG$lower[,"95%"]<=0))/12
mean.race.female <- min(which(forecast.Race.FemaleLONG$mean<=0))/12
max.bound.race.female <- min(which(forecast.Race.FemaleLONG$upper[,"95%"]>=2*race.Wts.Gen.fem[1]))/12 
decomp.race.female <- decompose(race.Wts.Gen.fem)
p.ch.race.female <- (decomp.race.female$trend[7] - decomp.race.female$trend[114])/decomp.race.female$trend[7] 
r.ch.race.female <- decomp.race.female$trend[7] - decomp.race.female$trend[114]

## Differenced series --------
race.Wts.diff.gender <- race.Wts.Gen.mal - race.Wts.Gen.fem
arima.race.diff.gender <- auto.arima(race.Wts.diff.gender, stepwise = FALSE, approximation = FALSE)
forecast.race.diff.gender <- forecast(arima.race.diff.gender, h = 60)
forecast.race.diff.genderLONG <- forecast(arima.race.diff.gender, h = 2400)
min.bound.race.gender.diff <- min(which(forecast.race.diff.genderLONG$lower[,"95%"]<=0))/12
mean.race.gender.diff <- min(which(forecast.race.diff.genderLONG$mean<=0))/12
max.bound.race.gender.diff <- min(which(forecast.race.diff.genderLONG$upper[,"95%"]>=2*race.Wts.diff.gender[1]))/12

r.ch.race.diff.gender <- decomp.race.diff.gender$trend[7] - decomp.race.diff.gender$trend[114]

r.ch.sex.femaleALL <- decomp.sex.femaleALL$trend[7] - decomp.sex.femaleALL$trend[162]

## Differenced series --------
sex.Wts.diff.genderALL <- sex.Wts.Gen.malALL - sex.Wts.Gen.femALL
arima.sex.diff.genderALL <- auto.arima(sex.Wts.diff.genderALL, stepwise = FALSE, approximation = FALSE)
forecast.sex.diff.genderALL <- forecast(arima.sex.diff.genderALL, h = 60)
forecast.sex.diff.genderALLLONGALL <- forecast(arima.sex.diff.genderALL, h = 2400)
min.bound.sex.gender.diffALL <- min(which(forecast.sex.diff.genderALLLONGALL$lower[,"95%"]<=0))/12
mean.sex.gender.diffALL <- min(which(forecast.sex.diff.genderALLLONGALL$mean<=0))/12
max.bound.sex.gender.diffALL <- min(which(forecast.sex.diff.genderALLLONGALL$upper[,"95%"]>=2*sex.Wts.diff.genderALL[1]))/12 
decomp.sex.diff.genderALL <- decompose(sex.Wts.diff.genderALL)
p.ch.sex.diff.genderALL <- (decomp.sex.diff.genderALL$trend[7] - decomp.sex.diff.genderALL$trend[162])/decomp.sex.diff.genderALL$trend[7]
r.ch.sex.diff.genderALL <- decomp.sex.diff.genderALL$trend[7] - decomp.sex.diff.genderALL$trend[162]
```

```{r codeRace, include=FALSE}
forecast.Race.WhiteLONG <- forecast(Race.arimaWhite, h = 2400)

mean.race.white <- min(which(forecast.Race.WhiteLONG$mean<=0))/12
max.bound.race.white <- min(which(forecast.Race.WhiteLONG$upper[,"95%"]>=2*race.Wts.Race.white[1]))/12

p.ch.race.white <- (decomp.race.white$trend[7] - decomp.race.white$trend[114])/decomp.race.white$trend[7]
r.ch.race.white <- decomp.race.white$trend[7] - decomp.race.white$trend[114]
```

## Political Differences.

```{r codePolitics, include=FALSE}
## Combine all data
race.Wts.Pol.consALL <- ts(c(race.Wts.Pol.cons, race.Wts.Pol.consNEW), start = c(2007, 1), frequency = 12)
age.Wts.Pol.consALL <- ts(c(age.Wts.Pol.cons, age.Wts.Pol.consNEW), start = c(2007, 1), frequency = 12)
sex.Wts.Pol.consALL <- ts(c(sex.Wts.Pol.cons, sex.Wts.Pol.consNEW), start = c(2007, 1), frequency = 12)
race.Wts.Pol.libALL <- ts(c(race.Wts.Pol.lib, race.Wts.Pol.libNEW), start = c(2007, 1), frequency = 12)
age.Wts.Pol.libALL <- ts(c(age.Wts.Pol.lib, age.Wts.Pol.libNEW), start = c(2007, 1), frequency = 12)
sex.Wts.Pol.libALL <- ts(c(sex.Wts.Pol.lib, sex.Wts.Pol.libNEW), start = c(2007, 1), frequency = 12)

## RACE ------
## Individual trajectories -------
## Fit to Conservatives
Race.arimaCons <- auto.arima(race.Wts.Pol.cons, stepwise = FALSE, approximation = FALSE)

r.ch.age.consALL <- decomp.age.consALL$trend[7] - decomp.age.consALL$trend[162] 
## Fit to Libs
Age.arimaLibALL <- auto.arima(age.Wts.Pol.libALL, stepwise = FALSE, approximation = FALSE)
forecast.Age.LibALL <- forecast(Age.arimaLibALL, h = 60)
forecast.Age.LibLONGALL <- forecast(Age.arimaLibALL, h = 2400)
min.bound.age.libALL <- min(which(forecast.Age.LibLONGALL$lower[,"95%"]<=0))/12
mean.age.libALL <- min(which(forecast.Age.LibLONGALL$mean<=0))/12
max.bound.age.libALL <- min(which(forecast.Age.LibLONGALL$upper[,"95%"]>=2*age.Wts.Pol.libALL[1]))/12 
decomp.age.libALL <- decompose(age.Wts.Pol.libALL)
p.ch.age.libALL <- (decomp.age.libALL$trend[7] - decomp.age.libALL$trend[162])/decomp.age.libALL$trend[7] 
r.ch.age.libALL <- decomp.age.libALL$trend[7] - decomp.age.libALL$trend[162]

## Differenced series --------
age.Wts.diff.polALL <- age.Wts.Pol.consALL - age.Wts.Pol.libALL
arima.age.diff.polALL <- auto.arima(age.Wts.diff.polALL, stepwise = FALSE, approximation = FALSE)
forecast.age.diff.polALL <- forecast(arima.age.diff.polALL, h = 60)
forecast.age.diff.polLONGALL <- forecast(arima.age.diff.polALL, h = 2400)
min.bound.age.pol.diffALL <- min(which(forecast.age.diff.polLONGALL$lower[,"95%"]<=0))/12
mean.age.pol.diffALL <- min(which(forecast.age.diff.polLONGALL$mean<=0))/12
max.bound.age.pol.diffALL <- min(which(forecast.age.diff.polLONGALL$upper[,"95%"]>=2*age.Wts.diff.polALL[1]))/12 
decomp.age.diff.polALL <- decompose(age.Wts.diff.polALL)
p.ch.age.diff.polALL <- (decomp.age.diff.polALL$trend[7] - decomp.age.diff.polALL$trend[162])/decomp.age.diff.polALL$trend[7]
r.ch.age.diff.polALL <- decomp.age.diff.polALL$trend[7] - decomp.age.diff.polALL$trend[162]
```

## Education Differences.

```{r codeEducation, include=FALSE}
## Combine all data
race.Wts.Edu.colALL <- ts(c(race.Wts.Edu.col, race.Wts.Edu.colNEW), start = c(2007, 1), frequency = 12)
age.Wts.Edu.colALL <- ts(c(age.Wts.Edu.col, age.Wts.Edu.colNEW), start = c(2007, 1), frequency = 12)
sex.Wts.Edu.colALL <- ts(c(sex.Wts.Edu.col, sex.Wts.Edu.colNEW), start = c(2007, 1), frequency = 12)
race.Wts.Edu.ncolALL <- ts(c(race.Wts.Edu.ncol, race.Wts.Edu.ncolNEW), start = c(2007, 1), frequency = 12)
age.Wts.Edu.ncolALL <- ts(c(age.Wts.Edu.ncol, age.Wts.Edu.ncolNEW), start = c(2007, 1), frequency = 12)
sex.Wts.Edu.ncolALL <- ts(c(sex.Wts.Edu.ncol, sex.Wts.Edu.ncolNEW), start = c(2007, 1), frequency = 12)

## RACE ------
## Individual trajectories -------
## Fit to > College
Race.arimaColl <- auto.arima(race.Wts.Edu.col, stepwise = FALSE, approximation = FALSE)
forecast.Race.Coll <- forecast(Race.arimaColl, h = 60)
forecast.Race.CollLONG <- forecast(Race.arimaColl, h = 2400)
min.bound.race.col <- min(which(forecast.Race.CollLONG$lower[,"95%"]<=0))/12
mean.race.col <- min(which(forecast.Race.CollLONG$mean<=0))/12

decomp.age.colALL <- decompose(age.Wts.Edu.colALL)
p.ch.age.colALL <- (decomp.age.colALL$trend[7] - decomp.age.colALL$trend[162])/decomp.age.colALL$trend[7]
r.ch.age.colALL <- decomp.age.colALL$trend[7] - decomp.age.colALL$trend[162] 
## Fit to NColls
Age.arimaNCollALL <- auto.arima(age.Wts.Edu.ncolALL, stepwise = FALSE, approximation = FALSE)
forecast.Age.NCollALL <- forecast(Age.arimaNCollALL, h = 60)
forecast.Age.NCollLONGALL <- forecast(Age.arimaNCollALL, h = 2400)
min.bound.age.ncolALL <- min(which(forecast.Age.NCollLONGALL$lower[,"95%"]<=0))/12
mean.age.ncolALL <- min(which(forecast.Age.NCollLONGALL$mean<=0))/12
max.bound.age.ncolALL <- min(which(forecast.Age.NCollLONGALL$upper[,"95%"]>=2*age.Wts.Edu.ncolALL[1]))/12 
decomp.age.ncolALL <- decompose(age.Wts.Edu.ncolALL)
p.ch.age.ncolALL <- (decomp.age.ncolALL$trend[7] - decomp.age.ncolALL$trend[162])/decomp.age.ncolALL$trend[7] 
r.ch.age.ncolALL <- decomp.age.ncolALL$trend[7] - decomp.age.ncolALL$trend[162]

## Differenced series --------
age.Wts.diff.eduALL <- age.Wts.Edu.colALL - age.Wts.Edu.ncolALL
arima.age.diff.eduALL <- auto.arima(age.Wts.diff.eduALL, stepwise = FALSE, approximation = FALSE)
forecast.age.diff.eduALL <- forecast(arima.age.diff.eduALL, h = 60)
forecast.age.diff.eduLONGALL <- forecast(arima.age.diff.eduALL, h = 2400)
min.bound.age.edu.diffALL <- min(which(forecast.age.diff.eduLONGALL$lower[,"95%"]<=0))/12
mean.age.edu.diffALL <- min(which(forecast.age.diff.eduLONGALL$mean<=0))/12
max.bound.age.edu.diffALL <- min(which(forecast.age.diff.eduLONGALL$upper[,"95%"]>=2*age.Wts.diff.eduALL[1]))/12 
decomp.age.diff.eduALL <- decompose(age.Wts.diff.eduALL)
p.ch.age.diff.eduALL <- (decomp.age.diff.eduALL$trend[7] - decomp.age.diff.eduALL$trend[162])/decomp.age.diff.eduALL$trend[7]
r.ch.age.diff.eduALL <- decomp.age.diff.eduALL$trend[7] - decomp.age.diff.eduALL$trend[162]
```

```{r codeAge, include=FALSE}
## Combine all data
race.Wts.Age.oldALL <- ts(c(race.Wts.Age.old, race.Wts.Age.oldNEW), start = c(2007, 1), frequency = 12)

## Individual trajectories -------
## Fit to Older respondents

r.ch.age.oldALL <- decomp.age.oldALL$trend[7] - decomp.age.oldALL$trend[162] 
## Fit to Youngs
Age.arimaYoungALL <- auto.arima(age.Wts.Age.youngALL, stepwise = FALSE, approximation = FALSE)
forecast.Age.YoungALL <- forecast(Age.arimaYoungALL, h = 60)
forecast.Age.YoungLONGALL <- forecast(Age.arimaYoungALL, h = 2400)
min.bound.age.youngALL <- min(which(forecast.Age.YoungLONGALL$lower[,"95%"]<=0))/12
mean.age.youngALL <- min(which(forecast.Age.YoungLONGALL$mean<=0))/12
max.bound.age.youngALL <- min(which(forecast.Age.YoungLONGALL$upper[,"95%"]>=2*age.Wts.Age.youngALL[1]))/12 
decomp.age.youngALL <- decompose(age.Wts.Age.youngALL)
p.ch.age.youngALL <- (decomp.age.youngALL$trend[7] - decomp.age.youngALL$trend[162])/decomp.age.youngALL$trend[7] 
r.ch.age.youngALL <- decomp.age.youngALL$trend[7] - decomp.age.youngALL$trend[162]

## Differenced series --------
age.Wts.diff.ageALL <- age.Wts.Age.oldALL - age.Wts.Age.youngALL
arima.age.diff.ageALL <- auto.arima(age.Wts.diff.ageALL, stepwise = FALSE, approximation = FALSE)
forecast.age.diff.ageALL <- forecast(arima.age.diff.ageALL, h = 60)
forecast.age.diff.ageLONGALL <- forecast(arima.age.diff.ageALL, h = 2400)
min.bound.age.age.diffALL <- min(which(forecast.age.diff.ageLONGALL$lower[,"95%"]<=0))/12
mean.age.age.diffALL <- min(which(forecast.age.diff.ageLONGALL$mean<=0))/12
max.bound.age.age.diffALL <- min(which(forecast.age.diff.ageLONGALL$upper[,"95%"]>=2*age.Wts.diff.ageALL[1]))/12 
decomp.age.diff.ageALL <- decompose(age.Wts.diff.ageALL)
p.ch.age.diff.ageALL <- (decomp.age.diff.ageALL$trend[7] - decomp.age.diff.ageALL$trend[162])/decomp.age.diff.ageALL$trend[7]
r.ch.age.diff.ageALL <- decomp.age.diff.ageALL$trend[7] - decomp.age.diff.ageALL$trend[162]

## Save all in a table ----------
```

```{r codeReligion, include=FALSE}
imp.rel.table$att <- rep(c("Age", "Race", "Sexuality"), each = 3)
imp.rel.table$grp <- rep(c("Christian", "Non", "Non - Christian"), times = 3)
imp.rel.table$start <- round(c(decomp.age.christian$trend[7], decomp.age.non$trend[7], decomp.age.diff.rel$trend[7],
                            decomp.race.christian$trend[7], decomp.race.non$trend[7], decomp.race.diff.rel$trend[7], 
                            decomp.sex.christian$trend[7], decomp.sex.non$trend[7], decomp.sex.diff.rel$trend[7]), 2) 
imp.rel.table$end <- round(c(decomp.age.christian$trend[114], decomp.age.non$trend[114], decomp.age.diff.rel$trend[114],
                            decomp.race.christian$trend[114], decomp.race.non$trend[114], decomp.race.diff.rel$trend[114], 
                            decomp.sex.christian$trend[114], decomp.sex.non$trend[114], decomp.sex.diff.rel$trend[114]), 2) 
imp.rel.table$pch <- round(c(p.ch.age.christian, p.ch.age.non, p.ch.age.diff.rel,
                             p.ch.race.christian, p.ch.race.non, p.ch.race.diff.rel,
                          p.ch.sex.christian, p.ch.sex.non, p.ch.sex.diff.rel)*100, 2)
imp.rel.table$rch <- round(c(r.ch.age.christian, r.ch.age.non, r.ch.age.diff.rel,
                             r.ch.race.christian, r.ch.race.non, r.ch.race.diff.rel,
                          r.ch.sex.christian, r.ch.sex.non, r.ch.sex.diff.rel), 2)

imp.rel.table$arima.pdq <- c(paste(arimaorder(Age.arimaChristian)[1:3], collapse = ","), paste(arimaorder(Age.arimaNon)[1:3], collapse = ","), paste(arimaorder(arima.age.diff.rel)[1:3], collapse = ","),
                             paste(arimaorder(Race.arimaChristian)[1:3], collapse = ","), paste(arimaorder(Race.arimaNon)[1:3], collapse = ","), paste(arimaorder(arima.race.diff.rel)[1:3], collapse = ","),
                            paste(arimaorder(Sex.arimaChristian)[1:3], collapse = ","), paste(arimaorder(Sex.arimaNon)[1:3], collapse = ","), paste(arimaorder(arima.sex.diff.rel)[1:3], collapse = ","))

imp.rel.table$arima.pdqS <- c(paste(arimaorder(Age.arimaChristian)[4:6], collapse = ","), paste(arimaorder(Age.arimaNon)[4:6], collapse = ","), paste(arimaorder(arima.age.diff.rel)[4:6], collapse = ","),
                              paste(arimaorder(Race.arimaChristian)[4:6], collapse = ","), paste(arimaorder(Race.arimaNon)[4:6], collapse = ","), paste(arimaorder(arima.race.diff.rel)[4:6], collapse = ","),
                            paste(arimaorder(Sex.arimaChristian)[4:6], collapse = ","), paste(arimaorder(Sex.arimaNon)[4:6], collapse = ","), paste(arimaorder(arima.sex.diff.rel)[4:6], collapse = ","))


imp.rel.table$arima.drift <- c(paste(ifelse(grepl("TRUE", grepl("drift", names(Age.arimaChristian$coef))), "drift", "n"), collapse = ""), 
                                  paste(ifelse(grepl("TRUE", grepl("drift", names(Age.arimaNon$coef))), "drift", "n"), collapse = ""),
                                  paste(ifelse(grepl("TRUE", grepl("drift", names(arima.age.diff.rel$coef))), "drift", "n"), collapse = ""),
                               paste(ifelse(grepl("TRUE", grepl("drift", names(Race.arimaChristian$coef))), "drift", "n"), collapse = ""), 
                                  paste(ifelse(grepl("TRUE", grepl("drift", names(Race.arimaNon$coef))), "drift", "n"), collapse = ""),

                                  paste(ifelse(grepl("TRUE", grepl("drift", names(Sex.arimaNon$coef))), "drift", "n"), collapse = ""),
                                  paste(ifelse(grepl("TRUE", grepl("drift", names(arima.sex.diff.rel$coef))), "drift", "n"), collapse = ""))

for (i in 1:nrow(imp.rel.table)){
  imp.rel.table$arima.drift[i] <- ifelse(grepl("drift", imp.rel.table$arima.drift[i]), "drift", NA)
}

imp.rel.table$minfor <- round(c(min.bound.age.christian, min.bound.age.non, min.bound.age.rel.diff,

}

}
```

## Sexuality Differences.

```{r codeSexuality, include=FALSE}
sex.Wts.Sex.strNEW <- sex.Wts.Sex.straightNEW # modify names to align with old data
sex.Wts.Sex.lesgayNEW <- sex.Wts.Sex.lesgayNEW
sex.Wts.Sex.bisexNEW <- sex.Wts.Sex.otherNEW

sex.Wts.Sex.strALL <- ts(c(sex.Wts.Sex.str, sex.Wts.Sex.strNEW), start = c(2007, 1), frequency = 12)
sex.Wts.Sex.lesgayALL <- ts(c(sex.Wts.Sex.lesgay, sex.Wts.Sex.lesgayNEW), start = c(2007, 1), frequency = 12)
sex.Wts.Sex.bisexALL <- ts(c(sex.Wts.Sex.bisex, sex.Wts.Sex.bisexNEW), start = c(2007, 1), frequency = 12)


## Individual trajectories -------
## Fit to Straight
Sex.arimaStraight <- auto.arima(sex.Wts.Sex.str, stepwise = FALSE, approximation = FALSE)
forecast.Sex.Straight <- forecast(Sex.arimaStraight, h = 60)
forecast.Sex.StraightLONG <- forecast(Sex.arimaStraight, h = 2400)
min.bound.sex.str <- min(which(forecast.Sex.StraightLONG$lower[,"95%"]<=0))/12
mean.sex.str <- min(which(forecast.Sex.StraightLONG$mean<=0))/12
max.bound.sex.str <- min(which(forecast.Sex.StraightLONG$upper[,"95%"]<=0))/12 # note switch because it has a drift parameter
decomp.sex.str <- decompose(sex.Wts.Sex.str)
p.ch.sex.str <- (decomp.sex.str$trend[7] - decomp.sex.str$trend[114])/decomp.sex.str$trend[7]
r.ch.sex.str <- decomp.sex.str$trend[7] - decomp.sex.str$trend[114] 
## Fit to Lesgays
Sex.arimaLesgay <- auto.arima(sex.Wts.Sex.lesgay, stepwise = FALSE, approximation = FALSE)
forecast.Sex.Lesgay <- forecast(Sex.arimaLesgay, h = 60)
forecast.Sex.LesgayLONG <- forecast(Sex.arimaLesgay, h = 2400)
min.bound.sex.lesgay <- min(which(forecast.Sex.LesgayLONG$lower[,"95%"]<=2*sex.Wts.Sex.lesgay[1]))/12 # note switch for this and all forecasts because it is starting out below
mean.sex.lesgay <- min(which(forecast.Sex.LesgayLONG$mean<=2*sex.Wts.Sex.lesgay[1]))/12
max.bound.sex.lesgay <- min(which(forecast.Sex.LesgayLONG$upper[,"95%"]>=0))/12 
decomp.sex.lesgay <- decompose(sex.Wts.Sex.lesgay)
p.ch.sex.lesgay <- (decomp.sex.lesgay$trend[7] - decomp.sex.lesgay$trend[114])/decomp.sex.lesgay$trend[7] 
r.ch.sex.lesgay <- decomp.sex.lesgay$trend[7] - decomp.sex.lesgay$trend[114]
## Fit to Bisexs
Sex.arimaBisex <- auto.arima(sex.Wts.Sex.bisex, stepwise = FALSE, approximation = FALSE)
forecast.Sex.Bisex <- forecast(Sex.arimaBisex, h = 60)
forecast.Sex.BisexLONG <- forecast(Sex.arimaBisex, h = 2400)
min.bound.sex.bisex <- min(which(forecast.Sex.BisexLONG$lower[,"95%"]<=0))/12
mean.sex.bisex <- min(which(forecast.Sex.BisexLONG$mean<=0))/12
max.bound.sex.bisex <- min(which(forecast.Sex.BisexLONG$upper[,"95%"]<=0))/12  # note switch because it has a drift.
decomp.sex.bisex <- decompose(sex.Wts.Sex.bisex)
p.ch.sex.bisex <- (decomp.sex.bisex$trend[7] - decomp.sex.bisex$trend[114])/decomp.sex.bisex$trend[7] 
r.ch.sex.bisex <- decomp.sex.bisex$trend[7] - decomp.sex.bisex$trend[114]

## Differenced series --------
sex.Wts.diff.strlesgay <- sex.Wts.Sex.str - sex.Wts.Sex.lesgay
arima.sex.diff.strlesgay <- auto.arima(sex.Wts.diff.strlesgay, stepwise = FALSE, approximation = FALSE)
forecast.sex.diff.strlesgay <- forecast(arima.sex.diff.strlesgay, h = 60)
forecast.sex.diff.strlesgayLONG <- forecast(arima.sex.diff.strlesgay, h = 2400)
min.bound.sex.strlesgay.diff <- min(which(forecast.sex.diff.strlesgayLONG$lower[,"95%"]<=0))/12 
mean.sex.strlesgay.diff <- min(which(forecast.sex.diff.strlesgayLONG$mean<=0))/12
max.bound.sex.strlesgay.diff <- min(which(forecast.sex.diff.strlesgayLONG$upper[,"95%"]>=2*sex.Wts.diff.strlesgay[1]))/12 
decomp.sex.diff.strlesgay <- decompose(sex.Wts.diff.strlesgay)
p.ch.sex.diff.strlesgay <- (decomp.sex.diff.strlesgay$trend[7] - decomp.sex.diff.strlesgay$trend[114])/decomp.sex.diff.strlesgay$trend[7]
r.ch.sex.diff.strlesgay <- decomp.sex.diff.strlesgay$trend[7] - decomp.sex.diff.strlesgay$trend[114]

## Differenced series Straight-Bisex

## Save all in a table ----------

imp.sexuality.table <- as.data.frame(matrix(nrow = 5, ncol = 12))
colnames(imp.sexuality.table) <- c("att", "grp", "start", "end", "pch", "rch", "arima.pdq", "arima.pdqS", "arima.drift", "minfor", "meanfor", "maxfor")
imp.sexuality.table$att <- rep(c("Sexuality"), each = 5)
imp.sexuality.table$grp <- c("Straight", "Lesbian/Gay", "Bisexual", 
                                 "Straight - Lesbian/Gay", "Straight - Bisexual")
imp.sexuality.table$start <- round(c(decomp.sex.str$trend[7], decomp.sex.lesgay$trend[7], decomp.sex.bisex$trend[7],
                            decomp.sex.diff.strlesgay$trend[7], decomp.sex.diff.strbisex$trend[7]), 2) 
imp.sexuality.table$end <- round(c(decomp.sex.str$trend[114], decomp.sex.lesgay$trend[114], decomp.sex.bisex$trend[114],
                            decomp.sex.diff.strlesgay$trend[114], decomp.sex.diff.strbisex$trend[114]), 2) 

imp.sexuality.table$pch <- round(c(p.ch.sex.str, p.ch.sex.lesgay, p.ch.sex.bisex, 
                          p.ch.sex.diff.strlesgay, p.ch.sex.diff.strbisex)*100, 2)

imp.sexuality.table$rch <- round(c(r.ch.sex.str, r.ch.sex.lesgay, r.ch.sex.bisex, 
                          r.ch.sex.diff.strlesgay, r.ch.sex.diff.strbisex), 2)

imp.sexuality.table$arima.pdq <- c(paste(arimaorder(Sex.arimaStraight)[1:3], collapse = ","),
                              paste(arimaorder(Sex.arimaLesgay)[1:3], collapse = ","),
                              paste(arimaorder(Sex.arimaBisex)[1:3], collapse = ","),
                              paste(arimaorder(arima.sex.diff.strlesgay)[1:3], collapse = ","),
                              paste(arimaorder(arima.sex.diff.strbisex)[1:3], collapse = ","))

imp.sexuality.table$arima.pdqS <- c(paste(arimaorder(Sex.arimaStraight)[4:6], collapse = ","),
                              paste(arimaorder(Sex.arimaLesgay)[4:6], collapse = ","),
                              paste(arimaorder(Sex.arimaBisex)[4:6], collapse = ","),
                              paste(arimaorder(arima.sex.diff.strlesgay)[4:6], collapse = ","),
                              paste(arimaorder(arima.sex.diff.strbisex)[4:6], collapse = ","))

imp.sexuality.table$arima.drift <- c(paste(ifelse(grepl("TRUE", grepl("drift", names(Sex.arimaStraight$coef))), "drift", "n"), collapse = ""), 
                                  paste(ifelse(grepl("TRUE", grepl("drift", names(Sex.arimaLesgay$coef))), "drift", "n"), collapse = ""),
                                paste(ifelse(grepl("TRUE", grepl("drift", names(Sex.arimaBisex$coef))), "drift", "n"), collapse = ""),
                                  paste(ifelse(grepl("TRUE", grepl("drift", names(arima.sex.diff.strlesgay$coef))), "drift", "n"), collapse = ""),
                                paste(ifelse(grepl("TRUE", grepl("drift", names(arima.sex.diff.strbisex$coef))), "drift", "n"), collapse = ""))

for (i in 1:nrow(imp.sexuality.table)){
  imp.sexuality.table$arima.drift[i] <- ifelse(grepl("drift", imp.sexuality.table$arima.drift[i]), "drift", NA)
}

imp.sexuality.table$minfor <- round(c(min.bound.sex.str, min.bound.sex.lesgay, min.bound.sex.bisex,
                             min.bound.sex.strlesgay.diff, min.bound.sex.strbisex.diff),2)

for (i in 1:nrow(imp.sexuality.table)){
  imp.sexuality.table$minfor[i] <- ifelse(grepl("Inf", imp.sexuality.table$minfor[i]), ">200 yrs", imp.sexuality.table$minfor[i])
}

imp.sexuality.table$meanfor <- round(c(mean.sex.str, mean.sex.lesgay, mean.sex.bisex,
                             mean.sex.strlesgay.diff, mean.sex.strbisex.diff), 2)

for (i in 1:nrow(imp.sexuality.table)){
  imp.sexuality.table$meanfor[i] <- ifelse(grepl("Inf", imp.sexuality.table$meanfor[i]), ">200 yrs", imp.sexuality.table$meanfor[i])
}

imp.sexuality.table$maxfor <- round(c(max.bound.sex.str, max.bound.sex.lesgay, max.bound.sex.bisex,
                             max.bound.sex.strlesgay.diff, max.bound.sex.strbisex.diff),2)

for (i in 1:nrow(imp.sexuality.table)){
  imp.sexuality.table$maxfor[i] <- ifelse(grepl("Inf", imp.sexuality.table$maxfor[i]), ">200 yrs", imp.sexuality.table$maxfor[i])
}
```

## Accuracy of demographic difference forecasts

``` {r demographicAccuracies, echo = FALSE}

# Create a TS matrix of past data
tsmat <- matrix(c(age.Wts.Gen.fem, age.Wts.Gen.mal, age.Wts.Race.white, age.Wts.Race.black, age.Wts.Race.asian,
                  age.Wts.Edu.col, age.Wts.Edu.ncol, age.Wts.Age.young, age.Wts.Age.old,
                  age.Wts.Rel.christian, age.Wts.Rel.jewish, age.Wts.Rel.non, age.Wts.Rel.other,
                  age.Wts.Pol.cons, age.Wts.Pol.lib,
                  race.Wts.Gen.fem, race.Wts.Gen.mal, race.Wts.Race.white, race.Wts.Race.black, race.Wts.Race.asian,

                  sex.Wts.Rel.christian, sex.Wts.Rel.jewish, sex.Wts.Rel.non, sex.Wts.Rel.other,
                  sex.Wts.Pol.cons, sex.Wts.Pol.lib, sex.Wts.Sex.bisex, sex.Wts.Sex.lesgay, sex.Wts.Sex.str),
                nrow = 120)
colnames(tsmat) <- c("agefemale", "agemale", "agewhite", "ageblack", "ageasian",
                     "agecollege", "agenocollege", "ageyoung", "ageold",
                     "agechristian", "agejewish", "agenonreligious", "ageotherreligion",
                     "ageconservative", "ageliberal",
                     "racefemale", "racemale", "racewhite", "raceblack", "raceasian",

                     "raceconservative", "raceliberal",

                     "sexualitycollege", "sexualitynocollege", "sexualityyoung", "sexualityold",
                     "sexualitychristian", "sexualityjewish", "sexualitynonreligious", "sexualityotherreligion",
                     "sexualityconservative", "sexualityliberal",
                     "sexualitybi", "sexualitylesgay", "sexualitystr")

# Create a TS matrix of NEW data (to be tested against)
tsmatNEW <- matrix(c(age.Wts.Gen.femNEW, age.Wts.Gen.malNEW, age.Wts.Race.whiteNEW, age.Wts.Race.blackNEW, age.Wts.Race.asianNEW,

                  age.Wts.Pol.consNEW, age.Wts.Pol.libNEW,

                  race.Wts.Edu.colNEW, race.Wts.Edu.ncolNEW, race.Wts.Age.youngNEW, race.Wts.Age.oldNEW,
                  race.Wts.Rel.christianNEW, race.Wts.Rel.jewishNEW, race.Wts.Rel.nonNEW, race.Wts.Rel.otherNEW,
                  race.Wts.Pol.consNEW, race.Wts.Pol.libNEW,
                  sex.Wts.Gen.femNEW, sex.Wts.Gen.malNEW, sex.Wts.Race.whiteNEW, sex.Wts.Race.blackNEW, sex.Wts.Race.asianNEW,

                     "sexualitybi", "sexualitylesgay", "sexualitystr")


## Fit arima models and forecasts by column on training set
tsmat_arimas <- list()
tsmat_forecast <- list()
tsmat_accuracy <- list()
ts_rmse <- vector()
ts_mase <- vector()
ts_mae <- vector()
ts_Nin80 <- vector()
ts_Nin95 <- vector()

for(i in 1:dim(tsmat)[2]){ # loop over columns in matrix
  tsmat_arimas[[i]] <- auto.arima(tsmat[,i], approximation = FALSE, stepwise = FALSE) # fit ARIMA
  tsmat_forecast[[i]] <- forecast(tsmat_arimas[[i]], h = 48) # pull out forecast for horizon of 4 years
  tsmat_accuracy[[i]] <- accuracy(tsmat_forecast[[i]], tsmatNEW[,i])
  ts_rmse[i] <- tsmat_accuracy[[i]]["Test set","RMSE"]
  ts_mase[i] <- tsmat_accuracy[[i]]["Test set","MASE"]
  ts_mae[i] <- tsmat_accuracy[[i]]["Test set","MAE"]
  ts_Nin80[i] <- as.numeric(table(tsmatNEW[,i] < tsmat_forecast[[i]]$upper[,1] & 
                                    tsmatNEW[,i] > tsmat_forecast[[i]]$lower[,1]))[2]
  ts_Nin95[i] <- as.numeric(table(tsmatNEW[i] < tsmat_forecast[[i]]$upper[,2] &
                                    tsmatNEW[i] > tsmat_forecast[[i]]$lower[,2]))[2]
  ts_Nin95 <- ifelse(is.na(ts_Nin95), 48, ts_Nin95)
  print(i)
}


## Save all in a table ----
demog.acc.table <- as.data.frame(matrix(nrow = 48, ncol = 9))
colnames(demog.acc.table) <- c("att", "group", "MASE", "MAE", "RMSE", 
                            "Nin80", "Nin95", "Pin80", "Pin95")
demog.acc.table$att <- c(rep(c("Age", "Race", "Sexuality"), each = 15), rep("Sexuality", each = 3))
demog.acc.table$group <- c(rep(c("Female", "Male", "White", "Black", "Asian", ">College", "<College", "Young", "Old",
                "Christian", "Jewish", "Non-religious", "Other religion", "Conservative", "Liberal"), times = 3),
                "Bisexual", "Lesbian/Gay", "Straight")
demog.acc.table$MASE <- round(c(ts_mase), 2) 
demog.acc.table$MAE <- round(c(ts_mae), 2) 
demog.acc.table$RMSE <- round(c(ts_rmse), 2) 
demog.acc.table$Nin80 <- c(ts_Nin80)
demog.acc.table$Nin95 <- c(ts_Nin95)
demog.acc.table$Pin80 <- (c(ts_Nin80)/48)*100
demog.acc.table$Pin95 <- (c(ts_Nin95)/48)*100
```
